limitations: No physical experiment or CFD solver output is represented.
The prescribed loss coefficient is an input to the reference model, not a validated prediction.
The dataset tests conservation, convergence and reporting logic only.
A real diffuser assessment also requires inlet-profile, turbulence, wall-resolution and separation evidence.
